# scm_dlp_forward_profile (Data Source)

> **Beta / Experimental:** Enterprise DLP support (`scm_dlp_*`) in `terraform-provider-scm` is currently in **Beta / Experimental** and subject to schema or behavior changes.

[Beta / Experimental] Retrieves details of an Enterprise DLP Forward Profile.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a DLP forward profile by its ID.
data "scm_dlp_forward_profile" "example" {
  id = "REPLACE_WITH_ID"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the forward profile.

### Read-Only

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the forward profile is enabled.
- `name` (String) The name of the forward profile.
- `regions` (List of String) List of regions to filter forwarded logs.
- `tfid` (String) The Terraform ID.
